name: Huntington Bank Pavilion at Northerly Island

bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC tote bags no larger than 12 × 6 × 12 inches and nonclear clutch bags no larger than 6 × 9 inches are allowed. Larger medical bags undergo additional screening.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking is not included in the concert ticket, and the venue recommends reserving in advance. Lots open one hour before the scheduled gate time.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Normal drop-off is near Adler Planetarium and pickup is on McFetridge Drive in front of the Field Museum. For expanded-lawn shows, both use the Field Museum.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverages are sold on site; guests may also bring food in a clear one-gallon bag and up to one gallon of water in a factory-sealed or empty plastic reusable bottle.
allowed: Water up to one gallon in a factory-sealed or empty plastic bottle
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue allows larger screened medical bags, including a separate bag for breast-pumping equipment. Ask guest services about seating or other accommodations.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: No re-entry after leaving, except when a severe-weather evacuation is cleared; keep the ticket for re-scanning after such an evacuation.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue visit FAQ does not publish a universal concert will-call collection point or time.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Gates usually open 60–120 minutes before showtime, but the exact time varies by show. Check the show’s event page; parking opens one hour before the gate time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
